objective.en: Track active lava from Kilauea's 2018 eruption so Hilo-area responders know which areas are burning.

sources.name: NASA Suomi NPP VIIRS 375 m thermal anomalies (GIBS layer VIIRS_SNPP_Thermal_Anomalies_375m_All)
sources.usage: Hazard cells = cells with Suomi NPP VIIRS 375 m thermal anomalies during the 2018 lower Puna eruption of Kilauea (eruption began 3 May; mission window 28 May - 10 June 2018), restricted to Kilauea's summit and rift zones (south of 19.6 N) and excluding hot spots already present on 2018-04-10..2018-04-15; seen on two or more days = strongest. Detections from 2018-05-03 count; eventDay = first mission day (from 2018-05-28) a cell was hot, 0 if it was already hot before the window.

sources.name: Mission: Possible cloud and detectability model
sources.usage: cloudProbability (baseline 0.5 for this volcano setting) and detectability are seeded educational estimates, not observations.
